import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSheaf
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4KaehlerDifferentialSections

/-!
# The presheaf of section-ring differentials

Restriction of functions induces restriction of Kahler differentials.
The generic-germ maps give a natural comparison with regular rational
differentials, including on the empty open.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Opposite

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))

@[reducible] private def differentialSectionAlgebra (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Algebra k Γ(X.left, U) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] differentialSectionAlgebra

/-- Restriction of section-ring differentials. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialRes {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k] →ₗ[k] Ω[Γ(X.left, V)⁄k] := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) :=
    (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    exact (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE h).op a).symm
  exact (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V)).restrictScalars k

@[simp] lemma kaehlerDifferentialRes_D {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (a : Γ(X.left, U)) :
    kaehlerDifferentialRes X h (KaehlerDifferential.D k Γ(X.left, U) a) =
      KaehlerDifferential.D k Γ(X.left, V)
        ((X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom a) := by
  simp [kaehlerDifferentialRes]
  rfl

lemma kaehlerDifferentialRes_smul {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (a : Γ(X.left, U)) (η : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]) :
    kaehlerDifferentialRes X h (a • η) =
      (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom a • kaehlerDifferentialRes X h η := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) :=
    (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    exact (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE h).op r).symm
  change KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) (a • η) =
    algebraMap Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) a • _
  rw [map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
  rfl

lemma kaehlerDifferentialRes_id (U : X.left.Opens) :
    kaehlerDifferentialRes X (le_refl U) = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro η
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := KaehlerDifferential.linearCombination_surjective k Γ(X.left, U) η
  induction l using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add l m hl hm => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hl hm
  | single a b =>
    simp [kaehlerDifferentialRes_smul]

lemma kaehlerDifferentialRes_comp {U V W : X.left.Opens}
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    kaehlerDifferentialRes X (hWV.trans hVU) =
      (kaehlerDifferentialRes X hWV).comp (kaehlerDifferentialRes X hVU) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro η
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := KaehlerDifferential.linearCombination_surjective k Γ(X.left, U) η
  induction l using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add l m hl hm => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hl hm
  | single a b =>
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      kaehlerDifferentialRes_smul, kaehlerDifferentialRes_D]
    have hres : X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op =
        X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫
          X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op := by
      rw [← X.left.presheaf.map_comp]
      rfl
    rw [hres]
    rfl

/-- The presheaf of Kahler differentials of the structure-sheaf section rings. -/
def kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf : X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Ω[Γ(X.left, U.unop)⁄k]
  map i := ModuleCat.ofHom (kaehlerDifferentialRes X (leOfHom i.unop))
  map_id U := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    exact kaehlerDifferentialRes_id X U.unop
  map_comp i j := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    exact kaehlerDifferentialRes_comp X (leOfHom j.unop) (leOfHom i.unop)

variable [IsIntegral X.left]

open Classical in
/-- The comparison with regular differentials, extended by zero on the empty open. -/
def kaehlerToRegularApp (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k] →ₗ[k] regularDifferentialSections X U :=
  if hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty then
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨hU.choose, hU.choose_spec⟩⟩
    kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U hU
  else 0

lemma kaehlerToRegularApp_nonempty (U : X.left.Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    kaehlerToRegularApp X U = kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U hU := by
  classical
  simp only [kaehlerToRegularApp, dif_pos hU]

lemma kaehlerToRegularApp_res {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (η : Ω[Γ(X.left, U)⁄k]) :
    kaehlerToRegularApp X V (kaehlerDifferentialRes X h η) =
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes X h (kaehlerToRegularApp X U η) := by
  by_cases hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · have hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty := hV.mono h
    letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨hV.choose, hV.choose_spec⟩⟩
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨hU.choose, hU.choose_spec⟩⟩
    rw [kaehlerToRegularApp_nonempty X V hV, kaehlerToRegularApp_nonempty X U hU]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X h hV,
      kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe, kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe]
    letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) :=
      (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      ext a
      exact (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE h).op a).symm
    haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField :=
      curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X U
        ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) hU⟩
    haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField :=
      curveSectionStalkOver_isScalarTower X V
        ⟨genericPoint X.left, genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) hV⟩
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      ext a
      exact (X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE h) (genericPoint X.left)
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (X := X) hV) a).symm
    have hcomp :
        ((KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField).restrictScalars
          Γ(X.left, U)).comp
            (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V)) =
          KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X.left, U) X.left.functionField := by
      ext a
      simp [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X.left, U) Γ(X.left, V)
        X.left.functionField]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp η
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hV
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- The natural generic-germ comparison from section-ring differentials to
regular rational differentials. -/
def kaehlerToRegularDifferentials :
    kaehlerDifferentialPresheaf X ⟶ regularDifferentialPresheaf X where
  app U := ModuleCat.ofHom (kaehlerToRegularApp X U.unop)
  naturality {U V} i := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro η
    exact kaehlerToRegularApp_res X (leOfHom i.unop) η

lemma kaehlerToRegularDifferentials_app_nonempty
    {U : X.left.Opens} [Nonempty U] (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    (kaehlerToRegularDifferentials X).app (op U) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (kaehlerSectionsToRegularDifferentials X U hU) := by
  exact congrArg ModuleCat.ofHom (kaehlerToRegularApp_nonempty X U hU)

end
end Hartshorne
